tradingPolicy.label: Safe Trade
tradingPolicy.scope: AI risk preferences shared with native new entries; additional native guards apply. Existing stops never loosen; exits are exempt from entry frequency gates
tradingPolicy.confidenceMeaning: Uncalibrated model filter, never a probability or sizing input

forwardCohort.valuationMethod: Fresh top-bid account marks including paid paper fill fees. Hypothetical exit costs and intra-sample execution are unknown.
forwardCohort.cashBenchmark: Same-quote uninvested cash: 0 nominal return; no interest or FX adjustment.
forwardCohort.warning: Short prospective paper observations do not establish an advantage. Downtime may have missed strategy signals and protective executions; endpoint values do not reconstruct that path.
forwardCohort.reason: Both accounts need their own clean baseline for the same execution version

forwardEvidence.valuationMethod: Fresh top bid for held positions; paid fill fees included in cash. Hypothetical exit fees/depth and live fills are not modelled.
forwardEvidence.reason: Requires active account, connected market and flat balance before this version trades

ruleFunnel.trialCountScope: This diagnostic run only; prior experiments remain inspected
ruleFunnel.warning: Counts and percentiles describe correlated historical features, not independent trades or future profit probabilities. First-failure counts depend on gate order; independent failures overlap. Raw diagnostics remain in the local report. No thresholds relaxed or new winner selected.

comparison.warning: Same-input historical comparisons are descriptive only; already-inspected samples do not establish independent profitability.

fixedDataset.selectionMethod: Volume-ranked current markets at capture; not a historical constituent universe

assumptions: Actual RuleBasedProvider, shared feature calculations and common entry/risk guards. No strategy or parameter selection.
Signals see only candles closed before the execution bar; decisions nominally occur +5s after the boundary. OHLC cannot resolve those five seconds or real latency.
Entry/exit fills approximate next-open/trigger plus configured spread and slippage. Historical books, queue position and market impact are unavailable.
UTC daily trade limits, coin cooldown, shared cash, lot rounding, exchange minimums, portfolio stop-risk and drawdown pause are modelled.
Stop-first on simultaneous intrabar levels; gap stops use the worse open. Liquidation at the evaluation end is artificial.
Protective intrabar exits assume executable liquidity. Known quantity/notional minimums are enforced; unliquidated dust remains marked at bid, not converted into fictional cash.

Paused accounts do not consult the provider. Failed protective exits latch and pause entries; retries use the next available bar open, a coarse approximation of live paper ticks/backoff. Successful recovery does not automatically resume.
Current surviving market universe and current exchange metadata introduce survivorship/metadata bias. No future profitability is established.
portfolioEvidence.warning: Actual rule-provider decisions, approximate historical OHLC execution. Retrospective report; small samples and current universe do not establish future profitability.

researchEvidence.method: Four fixed research presets, all reported; chronological 70/30 holdout plus three non-overlapping folds. No parameter search or strategy deployment. Research presets are not exact replays of the paper/live account strategies.
researchEvidence.warning: Research presets differ from the actual rule account. All presets shown; no winner selected. Retrospective results cannot establish future profitability.

longHorizonWindows.definitions: Rows correspond in order to windows; values correspond to columns. Complete windows require every UTC bar and the predecessor return anchor. Missing numeric metrics stay null; no older-bar backfill. Returns are close-to-close; drawdown uses the anchor and closes, not intrabar fills. Volatility is sample standard deviation of15m log returns in percent, not annualized. Correlation uses exactly paired15m log returns; zero variance is undefined even with complete data. Base volume is not quote/trade-level VWAP. Display values use10 significant digits; raw candles remain stored. Nested windows overlap and are not independent profit evidence.

marketContext.metricDefinitions: 24h/48h windows end at the latest closed UTC 15m boundary. Missing candles/return edges are not replaced by older data; incomplete metrics stay null. Volatility/correlation use close-to-close log returns. barApproxVwapLast24h weights OHLC typical price by bar volume, not observed trade-level VWAP.
marketContext.unitConvention: Legacy fields amountEur/costEur/volume24hEur are amounts in quoteCurrency; no FX conversion.

nativePolicy.source: Read-only dashboard AI preferences; separate native account/journal

activity.scope: Native non-rejected intent attempts, including no-fill/unknown outcomes; not fills, fees or profit. Exit times are conservative validated observation times, never reconstructed exchange execution timestamps.

existingProtection.scope: Existing exchange stops retained; actual fill/fees unverified

nativePolicy.stopBasis: Conservative working-limit estimate plus fee reserve, upward tick rounding; actual fill/fees unverified

publicCapture.timestampPolicy: Local request-start timestamps; no exchange-depth timestamp attestation. Account audited after public history/optional sources and final books.
publicCapture.historyScope: Separate network/quote public cache;90-day repair target, bounded1000-bar pages. Coverage reports expose gaps, partial history and errors; no missing candle synthesis.

nativeOrderHistory.interpretation: Durable intents and recorded API observations, not a complete trade/fill/commission ledger or PnL history. Accepted means a list was acknowledged, not that an entry filled or remained protected. Original packets remain in the native journal; summaries carry their hashes. No missing fills or fees reconstructed.
